title: AIGIS
description: 6,000+ downloads on npm and PyPI. An open-source AI governance CLI: one command compiles a plain-English project description into a deterministic governance brief mapped against NIST AI RMF, OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, and ISO/IEC 42001, with byte-identical output and overclaim detection. Built for the coding-agent era: governance content structured for AI agents first, humans second.

title: Tokenomics
description: ~90% LLM API cost reduction ($0.218 to $0.014 across a 50-query benchmark) with quality preserved. Tokenomics is a token-aware optimization layer between your application and LLM providers: it decides, per query, whether to answer from cache, compress the prompt, or route to the cheapest capable model. Savings attribution: UCB bandit routing ~75%, semantic caching ~22%, prompt compression ~3%.

title: AdVantage Ecosystem
description:
Driving a New Era of Learning with Peer-to-Peer Collaboration and Community Innovation
Advantage Ecosystem is a next-generation educational platform designed to foster decentralized, peer-to-peer learning networks. Our mission is to make education more engaging, inclusive, and practical by creating a dynamic ecosystem where students, professionals, and communities collaborate seamlessly.

title: The Solaris Mission (Community + Podcast)
description: The Society for Outer Life and Advanced Research on Interstellar Settlements: a space-science community exploring astronomy, outer life, and interstellar settlement through a podcast, blog, and community content.

title: Veritas RAG
description: ~2-3 ms P50 retrieval latency, ~230 ms cold start on a ~10k-chunk corpus. A portable, local-first retrieval engine that packages your knowledge into a shippable "retrieval artifact" for fast, offline, privacy-preserving search, with no vector database and no server.
